result.reasoning_summary: FW-NET-002 candidate implements immutable bounded caller-supplied network metadata validation with strict tenant isolation and evidence-first ordering. Frozen dataclass, hardcoded DRY_RUN/DETECT_ONLY, and authority_granted=False prevent unauthorized mutation or network operations. Evidence is written before return, excludes sensitive values (source/destination/indicators), and fails closed on write errors. Tenant mismatch, cross-tenant owner-references, enum validation, bounds checking, and type confusion (bool-as-int) are all tested. No sockets, packets, queries, or response authority in scope. Deterministic checks pass; 16 focused tests validate core security properties. Non-blocking gaps exist around empty indicators semantics and port boundary testing, but core logic is sound and meets all stated requirements.
